title: Better Tech
description: Better Tech is a Fabric tech mod for Minecraft 1.21.1 designed to eliminate over-complicated setups.
body:
# Better Tech 1.1.0 ⚡

Simple, compact tech for Minecraft 1.21.1 🏭

Better Tech adds BT power, machines, belts, pipes, fluids, reactors and factory
building blocks without depending on an external energy or fluid API. It is made
to feel readable in-game: clear machines, complete recipes, vanilla-style
textures and an in-game guide through `/better-tech help`, `/bettertech help` or
`/bt help` 📘

## What You Can Build 🛠️

- ⚡ Power grids with generators, batteries, transformers and cables.
- 🤖 Automated processing lines with machines, belts, item pipes and fluid pipes.
- 🌊 Water and lava routing with pumps, tanks, filters and fluid machines.
- ☢️ Reactor setups with Uranium Fuel Cells, Coolers and Heat Vents.
- 🏗️ Industrial factories using panels, grates, glass, lights and tech floors.

## New In 1.1.0 🚀

- 🏭 Big Factory + Build expansion with new machines, storage, cables and building blocks.
- ⚡ All-or-nothing BT power: machines pause when the network cannot supply every active machine.
- 🔧 New production chains for plates, circuits, processors, motors, plastics, coolant, superconductors and quantum parts.
- 🔋 Capacitor Bank, Quantum Battery and Superconductor Cable for late-game power networks.
- 🎮 Complete survival crafting for everything except the Creative Power Generator.
- 🎨 Polished Minecraft-style textures and 3D models for the new component items.
- 📖 Expanded Help UI with Blocks, Items, Machines, Recipes, Machine Recipes and progression Chains.

## Requirements 📋

- ⛏️ Minecraft 1.21.1
- 🧵 Fabric Loader 0.19.2 or newer
- 🧩 Fabric API
- ☕ Java 21 or newer
